claims.text: Each suite has its own design, an oversized bathroom and floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: each offering a curated and unique design, oversized bathrooms, and floor-to-ceiling windows to soak up Melbourne's iconic streets and laneways.

claims.text: Penthouse I has a separate lounge, an eight-seat dining area, a juke box and a marble bar.

findings.quote: complete with a separate lounge, eight-seater dining area, juke box and a marble bar

claims.text: The in-room bar was created with local makers.

findings.quote: We've connected with local makers to bring our in-room bar experience to life in true creative Melbourne style.

claims.text: The FIT gym has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city centre.

findings.quote: Tune into your workout with our state-of-the-art, fully equipped FIT gym, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Melbourne CBD.

claims.text: There is a steam room on Level 14.

findings.quote: Unwind in our steam room on Level 14, a calm escape above the city.

claims.text: A W Insider runs regular property tours about the hotel's design and art collection.

findings.quote: Connect with our W Insider who conducts regular property tours of the story behind our design narrative and collection of art.

claims.text: Marvel Stadium is within walking distance, and the MCG, Rod Laver Arena and Melbourne Park are a quick tram ride away.

findings.quote: Walk to Marvel Stadium, or take a quick tram ride to the MCG, Rod Laver Arena and Melbourne Park

claims.text: Warabi serves a Japanese omakase and a seasonal a la carte menu.

findings.quote: Warabi honours traditional Japanese culture and cooking techniques through an expertly crafted omakase journey and seasonal a la carte menu.

claims.text: The hotel is on Flinders Lane in Melbourne's city centre and draws its design inspiration from the surrounding laneways.

findings.quote: Located on the iconic Flinders Lane in the heart of Melbourne’s city centre, this luxury lifestyle hotel draws design inspiration from the laneways it sits between.

claims.text: WET, the Level 14 pool deck, has a poolside bar, city views and gold curved roofing and walls inspired by the Yarra River.

findings.quote: Located on Level 14 with a poolside bar and panoramic city views, WET is inspired by the curves of the Yarra River, where opulent gold curved roofing and walls meet a traditional Aussie pool deck.

claims.text: Suites are inspired by the tailors of Flinders Lane and styled like a high-fashion boutique.

findings.quote: Inspired by the tailors of Flinders Lane and the laneway culture they helped shape, our suites channel the energy of a high-fashion boutique; rich in colour, layered in texture, and made to be seen.

claims.text: Penthouse I, the hotel's largest suite, has floor-to-ceiling windows and a wrap-around balcony.

findings.quote: Enjoy the view from the top with W Melbourne’s largest luxury hotel suite spanning 175sqm, featuring a floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious wrap-around balcony.

claims.text: Curious, the hotel's hidden cocktail bar, has a cocoon-like ceiling of spiralling timber beams.

findings.quote: Curious is shaped by Hachem’s cocoon-like ceiling of spiralling timber beams.

claims.text: From 7pm, the WET pool deck is reserved for guests aged 16 and over.

findings.quote: Access is available to guests 24/7 and transforms to an adult-only space (ages 16+) from 7pm daily.

claims.text: Bringing a pet requires booking the Pets Are Welcome package.

findings.quote: the package is required to be booked if you want to bring them along.

claims.text: The hotel suggests leaving the car at home; reserved valet spaces are limited.

findings.quote: If you can, we recommend leaving your wheels at home. A limited number of reserved valet parking spots are available to book prior to arrival
